title: A CSAF web URI must begin with https://
rationale: CSAF is not an RFC 9116 field. IANA registered it in the "security.txt Fields" registry on 2023-02-15 as a "Link to a provider-metadata.json resource of the Common Security Advisory Framework (CSAF)", and the registry record states no scheme requirement. This rule applies the web-URI sentence RFC 9116 attaches to each of its own link fields, as sectxt (DigitalTrustCenter/sectxt) does: it lists csaf among its URI fields and reports no_https for an http value. It is local policy, not conformance, because no published CSAF clause in an immutable source backs it.

derivedFrom.quote: If this field indicates a web URI, then it MUST begin with "https://" (as per Section 2.7.2 of [RFC7230]).

applicability: A security.txt body with at least one CSAF value.

cases.name: no CSAF field -- the field is optional
